claim: NON-ISSUE: at every one of 22 sampled instants between 09:52:12Z and 10:00Z on 2026-09-29 the live VM's checked-out HEAD was at most 1 commit and ~2.5-3.5 min behind origin/main, i.e. within one ict-git-sync interval.
evidence: scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh version (git_sha_on_disk) vs `git fetch origin main; git rev-parse origin/main`, sampled every ~30s by scratchpad/samp.sh. 09:52:12Z disk=92b748d10 main=11b9e688a (main tip committed 09:50:05Z => lag 2m07s, behind=1); 09:53:31Z onward disk=11b9e688a behind=0 (caught up within 3m26s of commit); all later samples behind=0. The probe CAN see a positive: sample 1 returned behind=1.
expected: disk HEAD == origin/main within ~5 min (timer OnUnitActiveSec=5min + RandomizedDelaySec=30).
actual: max observed lag 3m26s; caught up on the next sync tick.
population: n=22 samples (3 + 13 from the 30s sampler + 6 at 25s) over ~8 min, one 5-min-cadence timer; main advanced only during the first ~4 min (tip 11b9e688 committed 09:50:05Z, unchanged after); does not cover overnight or a git-sync failure window.
detector: none added; a continuous detector would compare /api/diag/version git_sha_on_disk to origin/main and alarm at >10 min (not built).

claim: /api/diag/version reports restart_pending=true whenever the running sha differs from HEAD even when every intervening commit is docs/.github-only, which deploy_pull_restart.sh deliberately does not restart for, so the flag is true for most of the day while nothing is stale.
evidence: `diag_fetch.sh version` at 09:54:58Z -> {"git_sha":"b9d518516","git_sha_on_disk":"11b9e688a","restart_pending":true}. `git diff --name-only b9d518516 92b748d10` -> only .github/merge-slots, .github/pr-*, docs/claude/work/* (all in the non-runtime skip set of deploy_pull_restart.sh lines ~312-331). Last runtime commit 0fa97802 (09:32:33Z) precedes web-api sha b9d51851 (09:34:19Z) and trader boot_utc 09:37:59Z, so running code IS current.
expected: restart_pending true only when a runtime-path commit (src/, config/, scripts/, deploy/, ml/, comms/) is not loaded.
actual: true with zero runtime commits outstanding.
population: 3 consecutive samples 09:52-09:55Z; 1 window. Frequency over a day not measured.
detector: A test asserting restart_pending is computed with the same non-runtime path filter as deploy_pull_restart.sh (none exists).
proposed_fix: src/web/api/routers/diag.py version(): compute restart_pending as 'git diff --name-only running..disk' filtered by the deploy script's non-runtime regex is non-empty; else False.

claim: runtime_status.json git_sha (surfaced as /api/diag/status status.git_sha) is resolved live from the working tree, so it changes without the trader restarting and cannot show what code the trader process runs.
evidence: `diag_fetch.sh status` at 09:52:08Z: bot_uptime_s=845, boot_utc=2026-09-29T09:37:59Z, git_sha=92b748d10. Same process (boot_utc unchanged, uptime 993 at 09:54:59Z) then reported git_sha=11b9e688a. src/web/api/routers/diag.py version() docstring: 'resolved by the same helper that powers runtime_status.json::git_sha'; running sha is the separate _RUNNING_GIT_SHA (web-api process, b9d518516).
expected: a field named git_sha on a process status names the sha that process loaded.
actual: it names the current checkout; the trader's own loaded sha is exposed nowhere I could read (only the web-api's).
population: 2 samples in one trader process lifetime (boot 09:37:59Z); n=1 process.
detector: none; RC-STORED-FIELD-READ-AS-ITS-NAME class. A test that a trader boot captures its sha once at import would catch it.
proposed_fix: src/main.py / runtime status writer: capture git sha once at process start into status.json as git_sha_running; keep git_sha_on_disk separate. Then deploy verification can compare the TRADER, not the web-api.

claim: NON-ISSUE: none of the 47 units the live services endpoint reports were in state failed at 09:52Z on 2026-09-29; ict-git-sync.service was inactive with its timer active and a sync completed at 09:53:06Z.
evidence: `diag_fetch.sh services` -> 47 units: 24 service inactive (oneshots between fires), 6+ active, 1 activating (ict-prop-feed.service), 0 failed; journalctl?unit=ict-prop-feed shows 'Deactivated successfully' at 09:52:32Z (the 'activating' was a ~25s oneshot run, not a stuck unit). ict-ib-gateway-watchdog.timer inactive is by design: deploy_pull_restart.sh/install_systemd_units.sh install it on the gateway VM only.
expected: no failed units, or a failed oneshot visible.
actual: none failed. Probe can see non-terminal states (saw 'activating'), but a failed state was never observed so 'failed' rendering is untested here.
population: 47 of 52 deploy/ top-level units (see next finding for the 5 unreadable); single instant.
detector: CA-A10-400/401 recommend an OnFailure= hook; none exists (see next finding).

claim: As of origin/main 11b9e688a no unit under deploy/ declares OnFailure=, so a failed oneshot behind an active timer still produces no push alert, which is the exact masking pattern of PI-20260927-YZRZQ725-0002.
evidence: `grep -rl OnFailure deploy | wc -l` -> 0 (git log since 2026-09-27 for deploy/ shows one commit, #13970, unrelated).
expected: CA-A10-402 recommended an OnFailure= alert; a fix landed or was filed.
actual: not fixed after 2 days; observed state: not merged/deployed.
population: all 52 deploy/ top-level + 7 trainer units, by grep; n=59 files.
detector: a CI guard that fails when a timer-driven oneshot .service lacks OnFailure=.
proposed_fix: deploy/*.service: add OnFailure=ict-notify-failure@%n.service (new template unit) or a shared drop-in installed by scripts/install_systemd_units.sh.

claim: Five units declared in deploy/ for the live VM have no read surface: /api/diag/services and journalctl?unit= both refuse them, so their state cannot be audited without SSH.
evidence: `diag_fetch.sh 'journalctl?unit=ict-heartbeat&lines=3'` -> 'host ANSWERED with HTTP 400'; same for ict-env-check, ict-smoke-once, ict-ib-gateway-reset. Set difference of deploy/ top-level units vs services endpoint: ict-env-check.service, ict-heartbeat.service, ict-heartbeat.timer, ict-ib-gateway-reset.{service,timer}, ict-smoke-once.service (7 files; ict-trainer-git-sync.* belong to the trainer).
expected: every deployed live-VM unit is in the diag allowlist, or is documented as intentionally unreadable.
actual: ict-heartbeat.timer (daily 13:00Z) is unobservable; the ib-gateway-reset timer runs on the gateway VM, which no relay reaches.
population: 52 deploy/ top-level units vs 47 reported; 7 not reported (2 belong elsewhere, 5 live-VM).
detector: a test that every deploy/*.timer name appears in the diag services allowlist or an explicit exemption list.
proposed_fix: src/web/api/routers/diag.py: add ict-heartbeat.{service,timer}, ict-env-check.service to the allowlist; document the gateway-VM exemption.

claim: NON-ISSUE: the trainer VM's checked-out HEAD was 2 commits / 8m49s behind origin/main at 09:56:27Z, inside its 15-minute ict-trainer-git-sync interval, and it had synced to the then-tip within 29s of that commit's timestamp.
evidence: issue #14062 (trainer-vm-diag run 36552100170) output: '## git' -> HEAD 3b87d1e99 (committed 2026-09-29T12:45:17+03:00 = 09:45:17Z), origin/main 11b9e688a, rev-list count 2; oldest missing commit 92b748d1 at 09:47:38Z => 8m49s; ict-trainer-git-sync.timer LastTriggerUSec 09:45:44Z, next 10:00:51Z, journal shows 09:30:23 and 09:45:44 runs, Result=success.

evidence: issue #14062: '## failed' section empty (probe shown to work on the live side only, see failed-unit-none-live; here the section was empty with no error); `list-timers` -> 8 timers listed with next-fire times; issue #14071 '## results': ict-trainer, -catchup, -forecast, -publish, ict-drift-retrain, -offload-drain, -promotion-readiness, ict-trainer-git-sync all Result=success. ict-orderflow-capture.service active/running since 2026-08-31T15:54:39Z, NRestarts=0.

actual: as expected; ict-trainer.timer last fired 00:41Z, next 2026-09-30 00:11Z (daily).
population: 9 services + 8 timers on the trainer; one instant.

evidence: repo `sha256sum deploy/trainer/ict-promotion-readiness.timer` -> 7b2b33def391...; trainer (#14071) -> eca3c9d54adf. The 8 others matched exactly. Repo says OnCalendar=*-*-* 04:00:00 +30min jitter; observed LAST fire 2026-09-29T04:28:48Z (matches repo schedule, not the cloud-init 'daily'). The installed content diff is in #14077 if it was read before landing (see AUD-5.md).
expected: installed == repo (unit comment: 'Edits must stay in lock-step').
detector: the #14071 hash comparison run as a scheduled trainer check; CA-A10-405 proposed the same.

claim: The trainer VM root filesystem was 93% used (42G of 45G, 3.6G free) at 09:58Z on 2026-09-29.
expected: headroom sufficient for a training cycle, dataset builds and journal growth.
actual: 3.6G free on the machine whose daily cycle builds datasets and writes model artifacts; a full disk fails the cycle silently unless a guard exists.
population: 1 instant, 1 filesystem; growth rate not measured (no second sample).
detector: none found among units read; health-snapshot may report disk, not verified.
proposed_fix: judgment: identify what holds 42G (#14077 top-dirs if read), then prune or resize; add a disk-free alarm at 90%.

claim: Four trainer units (ict-trainer, -catchup, -forecast, -publish) exist in the repo only as embedded text in deploy/training-vm-cloud-init.yaml, so no repo path reinstalls or updates them and a hash-check against a repo file is impossible.
evidence: `git ls-files deploy/trainer` lists 7 files, none for these four; `grep -n 'path: /etc/systemd/system/ict-trainer' deploy/training-vm-cloud-init.yaml` matches lines 49, 163 (and -publish). All four are loaded and firing on the trainer (#14062).
expected: every unit the fleet depends on has a repo-tracked file that a sync can verify.
actual: 4 of 8 timer-driven trainer units are unverifiable against the repo.
proposed_fix: deploy/trainer/: extract the four units from the cloud-init yaml as files and hash-check them like the others.
